description: Net price range in PLN, monthly upkeep, duration and what the price is made of, for a service and its answers, computed from the price list in code (the same as the quote assistant on the site). With all five answers it also returns the draft offer. Hosts with MCP Apps show the estimate as an offer card.

answers.description: Option ids chosen for the questions of the service (get_quote_questions): q1, q2, q3, when, budget.

description.description: The client's need in their own words (optional). Features it mentions, such as integrations, are priced in.

language.description: Language of the texts in the result. Default: en.

name: estimate_price

breakdown.description: Elements of the price list behind the estimate; the total is rounded.

service_span_pln_net.description: Lowest and highest price of the service over all answers.

weeks.description: Shortest and longest duration in weeks.

title: Estimate the price
